review_walkthrough: Sync a book's highlights to Obsidian; in Obsidian add '# my comment' and 'tags: [a, b]' to its properties.
Change the book's title in Review details and sync: only the title: line (and the block heading) change; comment and tags exactly as written.

known_risks: Conservative: an owned line with a comment, a multi-line value, or a key written in another form causes a refusal only when that property must change; the user then fixes it or opts out via generated_by.
Owned values written by serde_yaml (quoted when needed); the user's own lines are never rewritten.
Frontmatter with CRLF anywhere is refused when an update is needed (no line-ending conversion).
Rollback limitation unchanged (previous build rewrites notes wholesale if used to sync).
